title: removing the unused options and code paths of assemble() (seg_r, seg_frac, glue_r / lo / hi, contract, fork_tau, fork_peak, fork_r, fork_vtx, fork_cov) leaves every assembled graph identical

a.recipe: p16_infer.py without the dead options (about 90 lines fewer); hashes of all assembled graphs of VAL 873 for six registry names compared with the hashes taken before the change (temp/loop21/graph_hash.py)

rule.note: KEEP only if the graph hashes of all six names are IDENTICAL, evaluate.py --golden check reproduces the 6 golden entries, the spec tests pass and an ar-reviewer pass finds no caller of a removed option; else revert
